data.name: Challenge
data.description: %1/day [Swift Action], you can challenge a foe to combat. Choose one target within sight to challenge. Your melee attacks deal %2 extra damage whenever the attacks are made against the target of the challenge. Challenging a foe requires much of the cavalier's concentration. The cavalier takes a -2 penalty to his Armor Class, except against attacks made by the target of his challenge. The challenge remains in effect until the target is dead or unconscious or until the combat ends. Each cavalier's challenge also includes another effect which is listed in the section describing the cavalier's order.|CavalierChallengeTimes|CavalierChallengeLVL
